title: Lula Addresses 81st UN General Assembly in New York
seoTitle: Lula Speaks at UN in New York
subtitle: President Lula to attend UN session this Tuesday at 10 AM (Brasília time)
excerpt: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will address the 81st UN General Assembly in New York this Tuesday (22), starting at 10 AM (Brasília time).
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will address the 81st General Assembly of the United Nations (UN) this Tuesday (22) in New York, United States.

The event is scheduled to begin at 10 AM, Brasília time, and brings together representatives from various countries to discuss global agendas.

This participation marks the presence of the Brazilian head of state at the UN's main international forum, where topics of collective interest will be addressed.

With information from Agência Brasil.
